Class Deck

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.modelo.Deck
public class Deck extends Object
Model class representing a deck of cards in the TCG application.

A deck belongs to a player and contains a collection of cards with their respective quantities, stored as a HashMap mapping card IDs to quantities.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier
